bootlogd_enable.description: Enable the boot logging daemon to capture messages during system startup.

bootlogd_logfile.description: Path to the file where boot messages will be logged.

bootlogd_log_to_syslog.description: If enabled, also send boot messages to syslog (e.g., systemd-journald).

bootlogd_verbose.description: Include timestamps and process IDs (PIDs) in boot log entries for detailed diagnostics.

bootlogd_suppress_dups.description: Suppress repeated identical log lines to reduce log size and noise.

bootlogd_delay.description: Seconds to wait after boot before starting the logging daemon (allows early services to settle).

bootlogd_extra_opts.description: Additional command-line arguments passed directly to bootlogd (e.g., `-f` for forced overwrite, `-q` for quiet).

bootlogd_post_boot_actions.description: Commands to execute after boot logging begins (e.g., compress logs, send notifications, or trigger alerts). Each action is assigned a POST_BOOT_N variable in order.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what this post-boot action does (used as inline comment).

command.description: Shell command or script to run (must be safe, non-blocking, and non-interactive).
